placements.title: Stack changes argued from measured performance and cost gains
placements.frame: What performance and cost gains are offered as grounds for changing a data or infrastructure stack, and what do those gains trade against?
placements.why: The segment announces a migration from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for the analytics pipeline and justifies it with two stated gains, 10x query performance and lower licensing cost. The graph has no existing leaves or strata, so nothing can be reused. The theme of justifying technology changes by performance and cost is one future envelopes can keep feeding, so it is a theme rather than a one-time fact. The migration itself and the Q3 2026 timeline are position-grain evidence for this leaf, not separate leaves.
consulted: Strata reference: Architecture > TechnicalExplainers > ComparativeAnalyses weighed; a stratum mint was not made because only one standalone leaf is present
